contract.task_clause:
Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) such as F3CCCl3 are implicated in the decomposition of stratospheric ozone. Which of the following methods would be best suited to measurement of trace amounts (sub-ppb) of CFCs in an air sample?
Option A: Gas chromatographic separation of the air sample on a capillary column followed by electron capture detection
Option B: Gas chromatographic separation of the air sample on a packed column followed by thermal conductivity detection
Option C: Gas chromatographic separation of the air sample on a capillary column followed by flame ionization detection
Option D: Conversion of the sample of the chlorinated compounds to chloride ions, followed by titration with Ag+
